scientific_integrity: Deductive proof of general limit and exact census; finite enumeration independently tests small cases only. No independent audit or priority guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Only one propositional atom, complete two-level finite posets, uniform choice among glut-free persistent valuations, and fixed first-order sentences in world order plus signed unary atomic predicates. The theorem neither treats general frames, multiple atoms, growing quantifier rank, nor general Nelson-formula validity. An equivalent earlier asymptotic result could remain undiscovered.
title: Complete first-order crossover law for persistent three-valued valuations on two-level frames
